title: Verification in a process that cannot import what it checks
note: reconstruct.py keeps its independence by discipline: it restates the authority rules rather than importing the reducers. Discipline decays silently, so the same reader also runs in a process where the shortcut is unavailable. Every mutation here removes one of the things that makes that separation real, or one of the refusals that stops a broken verifier reading as a pass.

mutations.name: S1_the_import_guard_lets_the_primary_reducer_through
mutations.rationale: the second reading becomes a second call to the first implementation, which agrees with itself for free

mutations.name: S2_the_forbidden_set_is_empty
mutations.find:
if fullname in FORBIDDEN:
            raise ImportError(
mutations.replace:
if fullname in frozenset():
            raise ImportError(
mutations.rationale: VACUOUS: the guard consults an empty set, so it passes by examining nothing

mutations.name: S3_anomalies_do_not_change_the_exit_status
mutations.rationale: a log with forged transitions exits 0, so the caller reads a refusal as agreement

mutations.name: S4_an_unreadable_log_exits_zero
mutations.rationale: a log the verifier could not replay at all reports success over nothing

mutations.name: S5_a_crashed_verifier_is_a_pass
mutations.rationale: every non-zero exit, timeout and unreadable answer becomes agreement

mutations.name: S6_a_timeout_is_treated_as_success
mutations.rationale: a verifier that hangs never says no, which is not the same as saying yes

mutations.name: S7_an_unparseable_answer_is_a_verdict
mutations.rationale: an unparseable verdict is not a verdict

mutations.name: S8_a_missing_verifier_is_skipped_rather_than_refused
mutations.rationale: deleting the verifier becomes the cheapest way to make every run agree with itself

mutations.name: S9_the_production_path_does_not_consult_another_process
mutations.rationale: the mechanism exists and nothing calls it, which is the shape of a defence with no caller

mutations.name: S10_the_independent_refusal_changes_nothing
mutations.rationale: a verifier whose answer changes nothing is a log line, and this project has a name for those

mutations.name: S11_the_verdict_is_not_recorded
mutations.find:
self.log.append(
                actor=verifier, action=ACT_SEPARATE_VERIFY, target=task_id,
                payload={"task_id": task_id, **sep.to_record()})
mutations.rationale: 'the independent verifier refused' is exactly the fact an auditor must be able to find
